title: Knowledge Graph
description: One interactive graph over customer, contracts, offers, products, skills, tools, risks, agents and n8n workflows: explore neighbours, follow impact, find paths.
insights: Derived from the Sub4Me, Skill Marketplace, Control Tower and n8n sample data plus a few curated links; nothing is stored separately.
Impact mode shows what hangs on a node (for example the Ariba contract), Path mode shows how two nodes connect.
The same graph answers chat questions through the get_graph_overview, search_graph, get_graph_neighbors, find_graph_path and analyze_graph_impact tools.
prompt: Bundled example: Knowledge Graph (static, data embedded by npm run sync:knowledge-graph).
